question: In which year did the Indian gymnast Dipa Karmakar participate in the Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, i.e., Dipa Karmakar participated in the Olympics in the year 2016.**
 
• ** Dipa Karmakar **is an Indian gymnast who became the** first Indian female gymnast t**o qualify for the Olympics.
 
• She competed in the artistic gymnastics category.
 
• In the **2016 Olympics held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Dipa Karmakar** created history by becoming the first Indian gymnast to reach the finals of an Olympic event. She finished fourth in the women's vault event. 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3, i.e.,** Dipa Karmakar participated in the Olympics in the year 2016.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dipa Karmakar was only 14 years** old at that time and had not yet started her international gymnastics career.
 
• Dipa Karmakar did** not participate** in the **2012 Olympics held in London.**
 
• 2020 Olympics, originally scheduled to be held in Tokyo, Japan, were postponed to **2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic**.
